definitions.gloss: the start of the rainy season; the beginning of tsuyu
definitions.explanation: the official announcement by the Japan Meteorological Agency marking the beginning of the annual rainy season, typically in early June

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧、{関東地方|かんとうちほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{梅雨入|つゆい}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Today, the Kanto region entered the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {梅雨入|つゆい}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}かった→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The start of the rainy season was earlier than usual.

examples.japanese: {梅雨入|つゆい}り⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}こう→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
examples.english: Once the rainy season starts, make sure to carry an umbrella.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) + {入|い}り (entering) → entering the rainy season
{梅雨入|つゆい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enter the rainy season)

TIMING:
The Japan Meteorological Agency announces {梅雨入|つゆい}り for each region:
- ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧: early May
- ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧〜⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧: early to mid-June
- ⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧: mid-June
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: no official rainy season

ALTERNATE READING:
{梅雨入|ついり} (also valid)
